19,414 reviews. 4.5 stars. And most tourists still skip Sunworld Hòn Thơm.

This is the world's longest sea-crossing cable car. It takes you over open ocean to an island water park, all designed around Ancient Rome.

One ticket. Cable car ride + water park + a shopping hub with views that hit different at every angle.

Phu Quoc keeps surprising people. This is why.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
